comment: Queued work to make interactive-shell usable by a fresh agent on unfamiliar interactive terminals.

tasks.title: Make interactive-shell a discoverable unknown-TTY tool
tasks.detail: The current wrapper proves scripted transcripts but does not yet give a fresh agent enough observation, input, and discovery primitives to navigate unfamiliar TUIs safely.
tasks.note: Initial gaps recorded after the nano and attempted Midnight Commander exploration.

tasks.title: Add complete keyboard input coverage
tasks.detail: Support F5-F12 and complete Ctrl, Alt, Shift, navigation, and terminal-specific key combinations without requiring agents to handcraft raw escape sequences.

tasks.title: Add screen snapshots and resynchronization
tasks.detail: Provide a current full-screen snapshot, event-history or sequence inspection, and recovery after an agent misses a delta so screen state does not depend on perfect stream consumption.

tasks.title: Add structured mouse paste and resize actions
tasks.detail: Expose mouse clicks, movement, button release, bracketed paste, and PTY resize as structured operations with raw-byte fallback where appropriate.

tasks.title: Represent terminal attributes and scrolling
tasks.detail: Extend the screen model with colors, bold/reverse and other attributes, scrollback, scroll regions, insert/delete lines, and the terminal controls used by ncurses TUIs.
tasks.note: Current model explicitly omits these features.

tasks.title: Add agent-level observe-and-wait operations
tasks.detail: Offer a supported observe operation and optionally send-and-wait predicates so agents do not need to implement fragile external polling and screen reconstruction for every action.

tasks.title: Expose clickable elements and labels
tasks.detail: Provide an easy, structured way to obtain clickable or actionable screen elements with their labels, coordinates, and stable identifiers when the terminal or TUI exposes enough information to identify them.
tasks.note: Requested explicitly after the scripted MC test exposed that text recognition and selection were not enough.

tasks.title: Add click-by-element and click-by-coordinate actions
tasks.detail: Allow an agent to click a discovered element by stable identifier or label, and provide explicit coordinate clicking for TUIs that expose no semantic element metadata.

tasks.title: Add unknown-TUI exploration coverage
tasks.detail: Create an exploratory test driven only by observations and available actions against MC, nano, and less; do not encode a predetermined transcript or assume screen coordinates in advance.
